chunks: Ibn Muskan narrated from Ibrahim ibn Maymun, who said:
I said to Abu Abdullah عليه السلام: “A man plucked a pigeon from the pigeons of the Haram.”
He عليه السلام said: “He should give charity to a needy person, and give with the hand by which he plucked, for he has indeed caused it pain.”

key_terms.مِسْكِينٍ: a needy person who receives the charity
key_terms.ٱلْحَرَمِ: the sacred sanctuary whose animals are protected
key_terms.ٱلْيَدِ: the hand with which the act was committed

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on plucking the feathers of a pigeon in the Haram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for one who plucks the feathers of a pigeon belonging to the Haram. The expiation is to give charity to a needy person, and the wording emphasizes that the act caused pain to the animal, showing the sanctity of the Haram and the ethical seriousness of harming its creatures.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2363 - Ibn Muskan narrated from Ibrahim ibn Maymun:
I said to Abu Abdullah (as), "A man plucked the feathers of a pigeon from the pigeons of the Haram."
Imam (as) replied: "He should give charity to a needy person and with the hand that plucked the feathers, for he has caused it pain."
